Performed data profiling and validation on upstream risk, pricing, and exposure datasets.
Conducted reconciliation analysis between source systems and regulatory outputs to ensure accuracy and auditability.

Gathered, analyzed, and documented business and regulatory requirements for trade reporting, order flows, and transaction publication.
Collaborated with compliance and development teams to implement changes for accurate trade reporting and transparency under MiFID II guidelines.
Participated in functional testing and validation of regulatory reporting workflows to ensure data integrity and compliance.

Played a key role in mortgage data standardization by designing and implementing MISMO-compliant data models to support regulatory reporting, investor requirements, and enterprise data strategy. Partnered with stakeholders, architects, and cross-functional teams to improve data governance, lineage, and overall quality.
Designed and implemented MISMO v3.x compliant data models (conceptual, logical, physical), improving scalability and reusability while reducing redundancy by 30%.
Translated business requirements into reusable MISMO-compliant models, enabling faster system integration and accelerating project delivery by 20%.
Validated and optimized source-to-target data mapping across legacy and modern systems, enhancing data quality, consistency, and regulatory compliance by 25%.
Built and maintained data dictionaries, metadata repositories, and schema diagrams, strengthening data governance and reducing onboarding time for new analysts by 40%.
Incorporated evolving MISMO standards into enterprise data strategy, cutting technical rework by 15% and ensuring long-term compliance.

Analyzed existing trade schemas and data models, defined validation rules, and optimized post-trade workflows for improved STP rates and reduced exceptions. Collaborated with Front Office, Operations, and Technology teams to onboard new instruments and align trade data with regulatory and downstream reporting systems. Key Achievements:
Designed trade validation logic and data mapping for new asset classes (e.g., Fixed Income Derivatives, FX). Enhanced schema definitions and target mappings to support trade enrichment and booking accuracy. Led product enhancements for Global Fund Services Trade Processing.


Defined functional requirements and collaborated with IT teams for implementation

Key Contributions:

Supported change implementation for new system features and process enhancements, ensuring minimal business disruption and compliance with operational standards.
Performed daily trade and position validations, monitored exceptions, and implemented automation improvements to enhance reporting accuracy and turnaround time.

Supported multiple investment banking operations projects, focusing on trade processing, reconciliation, and process optimization.
